title: Power Rankings: Rockets rise into top five
heading: 2008-09 Power Rankings: Week 21
author: Marc Stein

rankings.summaryHtml: Spotty D. Inconsistent bench. A killer instinct publicly questioned by the coach. And still no Bynum. But you know what? Nothing's changed: Roughly 29 teams would trade for L.A.'s issues, just like we said in October.
